Commentary.Commentary: The target is a challenging one and it is going to be a real test for the Indian batters. The wicket did show signs of slowing up as the game progressed but it may just ease off under lights. Also if the dew sets in, Australia might just find themselves 20-30 runs short here. Join us in a while for the chase.

The Indian bowling looked out of sorts to begin with. They pacers were taken for runs at the start. The spinners who normally apply the breaks in the middle overs failed to do so. They though did extremely well to pull things back towards the end. Kuldeep finished with the most wickets as he had three to his name. Shami and Bumrah also fared well at the office. The rest though weren't quite upto the mark.

The Aussies though will still be pleased with their batting effort. They were led by their openers, Khawaja and Aaron Finch. The pair added 193-run with the right-hander falling 7 short of a ton, whereas, the left-hander scored his maiden ODI century. Maxwell then played a handy cameo and added yet another handy stand with Usman. When the two were batting 350 seemed possible. Australia though then lost their way. From 258 for 2 they slipped to 263 for 5 as their middle order hardly contributed anything. Cameos from Stoinis and Carey saw them go above the 300-run mark.

An excellent comeback from the Indians, they have not let Australia run away with the game here. For one moment it did seem that the Aussies would head into the break as clear favorites but it is somewhat even-stevens.
Full outside off, Stoinis hits it to covers and takes a single. 10 runs off the final over. Australia end with 313/5 off their 50 overs.
FOUR! Bullet! Slower delivery outside off, Stoinis whacks it through covers for a boundary. No chance stopping that one for any fielder.
Perfect execution. Over the wicket this time. Bumrah bowls it full and close to the tramline. Stoinis swings his bat but misses.
Comes 'round the wicket and bowls it on the pads, Alex tucks it to the leg side and takes a single.
FOUR! Carey makes room for himself and clears his front leg away from the line and thumps the length ball outside off through point for a boundary.
Starts the final over with a slower ball, full outside off. Carey looks to hit it with the line but gets beaten.

FOUR! The last ball spoils the over! Shami is guilty of bowling it on the pads, Stoinis flicks it through square leg and it races away to the fence. Much needed this. 10 from Shami's last. He though still has decent figures of 10-0-52-1.
Just 6 from the 5 balls bowled! Carey fails to put away a high full toss. He mistimes it towards cover for a single. This has been a good over so far. Can he end it well though?
A low full toss, not easy to get those away. Stoinis only manages to hit it down to long on and gets to the other end. 5 from the 4 balls bowled.
Another good delivery! Slower ball and full, Carey hits it through mid-wicket for a run.
A yorker on off, Stoinis jams it through mid off and takes a single. Good bowling, the over has started off well for Shami.
On the fuller side, Stoinis works it through mid-wicket. It is in the gap and the batsmen take two.
Yorker outside leg to finish off the over. Stionis looks to put bat on ball but misses. It hits his boot and they steal a leg bye.
FOUR! No power just pure placement. A very low full toss outside off, Stoinis just opens the face of the bat and guides it to the vacant backward square leg fence for a boundary.
Full outside off, Carey takes his front leg out of the way and hits it towards cover for a single.
Corker of a yorker. On middle and leg, Stoinis gets his bat down in time and gets an inside edge onto his boots. The ball goes behind and a single is taken.
Straight as an arrow. Good length delivery on middle, Stoinis moves away, wide of his leg stump and hits it straight. It goes on to hit the stump at the bowler's end.
Good length delivery outside off, Stoinis looks to hit it but takes his eyes off the ball and misses.

So a couple to end! Just two from the final three balls but an expensive over overall. It accounts for 11, shortish and outside off, Carey slaps it through covers. Rayudu runs to his left, slides and keeps it down to two.
Excellent slower ball! Carey uses his feet but Shami bowls it short and slower. Carey is way too early into the shot and he gets beaten.
Drags his length back and bowls it on middle, Carey looks to hit it over square leg but misses. He gets hit high on the pads. An appeal follows but the umpire shakes his head.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries! This is a better shot than the last one. Full and on middle, Carey strokes it back past the bowler and down to the long on fence.

FOUR! Carey Gets this one in the gap, beats the dive of Shankar and a boundary! Length ball around off, Carey makes room and then hits it to the right of Shankar at mid off. He dives over the ball and then it races to the fence.
Cramps the batsman for room by bowling it on the body, Stoinis punches it down to long on for a run.

Another quick run! Stoinis opens the face of the bat at the very end and guides it towards point. The batsmen set off for a run and complete it in the end. Just the three from his over. Top stuff from Bumrah.
Makes room and slaps it through covers for a run.
A full toss on the pads, Carey is beaten for pace as he fails to put bat on ball. It hits his pads and rolls towards covers. Carey wants a run but is sent back.
Another back of a length ball on off, MS guides it towards point and gets to the other end.
Length ball on off, Stoinis looks to block but gets it off the inner half towards mid-wicket.
Yorker to begin with on middle, Stoinis hits it back to the bowler.
Jasprit Bumrah is back into the attack now.
Single to finish off the over. Length ball on middle, Stoinis nudges it to long on and keeps the strike.
Length delivery on the pads, Carey tucks it towards leg side for a single.
On the pads, Marcus follows the boundary with a single towards mid-wicket.
FOUR! Short and punished. Shami attempts a slower bouncer. He ends up serving it on a good length for Stoinis to hit. Marcus obliges and cuts it through point for a boundary.
Good length delivery on middle, Carey tucks it towards mid-wicket and Carey gets off the mark.
Full toss on off, Stoinis tucks it to square leg and gets a single.
Mohammed Shami is back.
Outside off and left alone. A two-wicket over by Kuldeep and this is probably the over which changes the momentum of the game. He ends with figures of 10-0-64-3.
Tosses it up on off, Carey keeps it out.
Alex Carey is the new man in.

OUT! Two in three balls for Yadav and all of a sudden, half the side is back in the hut for Australia. Third for Kuldeep. Handscomb bags a duck. From 258 for 2, Australia are now 263 for 5. The leg spinner outside off, it pitches and then turns back in. PH looks to flick but misses. It hits him on the front pad. An appeal follows and the umpire raises the finger. Can India now keep Australia under 300? Now then... Hawk Eye shows the ball to be going over the stumps. No reviews left though for the Aussies.
Goes back and works it with the turn to mid-wicket.
Peter Handscomb walks out at number 6.

OUT! Another one bites the dust and Australia are losing their way here! Marsh is the man who is walking back. He uses his feet but does not get to the pitch of the ball. He still goes ahead with the shot but does not get the elevation he would have liked. Ends up hitting it flat towards long on. Shankar there runs to his right and takes a neat catch.
The googly on off, Stoinis picks it, he pushes it down to long off for a run.
Single to end the over. Loopy delivery outside off, Marcus pushes it to cover and keeps the strike.
On the middle stump line, Stoinis taps it back to the bowler.
Marsh comes down the track and nudges it to the leg side for a single.
Stoinis is off the mark. Tossed up ball on off, Marcus milks it to long off and gets to the other end.
Flighted outside off, Stoinis looks to play it on the off side but misses.
Flighted on middle, Jadeja tucks it towards deep mid-wicket and rotates the strike.
Marcus Stoinis is the new man in for Australia.

OUT! Maxwell is short! The Big Show has been run out. The last thing Australia would have wanted. But what brilliance first from Jadeja and then from Dhoni. Especially on a day where India have been lackluster in the field. Kuldeep bowls it short and outside off, Marsh goes back and slaps it hard towards cover and sets off for a run, thinking there is at least a couple on offer. Jadeja though first dives to his right and stops it, not cleanly but he recovers well and fires the ball to the keeper. Dhoni nonchalantly flicks it onto the stumps and appeals. The umpire takes it upstairs and replays show that Maxwell has to take the long walk back. The crowd erupts and the Indians are ecstatic. Maxwell was striking the ball really well there. This can make a huge difference to the final total as now there are two new batsmen out in the middle. 9 did come from the over but an important wicket too.
The square leg umpire has gone upstairs for a run out appeal. MS Dhoni is dead sure about it. Maxwell is the man in question. Let's see what is the answer from third umpire.
Quicker and on the pads, Maxwell looks to sweep but gets a top edge through backward square leg for a run.

NOT OUT! Maxwell is in! The googly from Kuldeep outside off, Maxwell swings again but misses. Dhoni collects the ball and whips the bails off. An appeal follows, the umpire goes upstairs late. Replays roll in and it shows the batsman is safe.
The square leg umpire has gone upstairs for stumping. MS Dhoni does not look confident and generally that means the batsman is safe. Let's see what the replays have to say.
On the shorter side outside off, Marsh slaps it through covers and gives the strike to the well-set batsman.
Now powers this down to long off for a run.
SIX! Welcome back into the attack! Maxwell makes room and then slaps it flat over the long on fielder and over the stands. Ideal start to the over and pressure on Kuldeep now.
Kuldeep Yadav is back into the attack.
Flatter on off, Maxwell pushes it to cover for a single.
Play and a miss. Straighter one outside off, Maxwell looks to hit it but the ball keeps low after pitching and he misses his shot.
On the pads, Shaun flicks it towards square leg for a single.
Flighted on middle, Marsh looks to defend but gets an inside edge onto the pads.

Almost a calamity for Australia. Tossed up delivery on off, Marsh tucks it wide of the mid-wicket fielder. Maxwell runs the first one hard and goes for the second. Marsh is slighlty hesitant for it but goes with it. The throw at the bowler's end is a lose one. Jadeja shoots at the keeper's end and hits but Marsh was in.
Arm ball to start up with, Maxwell looks to defend but it goes to the leg side off the inner half of the bat. Jadeja goes and gathers the batt but a single is taken.
Power play 3 signalled by the umpire. India can now have maximum of 5 fielders outside the inner circle. Ravindra Jadeja back into the attack.
A huge shout but not given! The yorker on middle, Maxwell gets some bat on it as it goes through square leg for a run.

Had Ambati Rayudu hit there, Maxwell was a goner! Marsh pushes it towards cover and takes off. Maxwell responds. AR is quick to the ball and has a shy at the keeper's end but misses to Maxwell's luck. Had that been another day, India might have hit the stumps. They have been poor today.
Once again it is worked with the angle towards mid-wicket for a run.
Another misfiled! Very poor this by the Indians. Full and on the pads, it is flicked towards mid-wicket. Rayudu there lets it through and the batsmen take two.
Good length again outside off, this one stays a touch low. Maxwell looks to defend it by getting right behind the line but is beaten by the low bounce.
Back of a length around off, Maxwell keeps it out.
Jasprit Bumrah is back into the attack.
Full and on the pads, Marsh flicks it to short mid-wicket. Just the two and a wicket from this over. India need a couple more of these overs.
Well bowled! Another slower ball outside off, Marsh first looks to guide it down to third man but then bails out.
Goes for the yorker first up, Marsh works it towards mid-wicket.
Shaun Marsh is the new man in.

OUT! Shami strikes! Khawaja departs soon after getting to his ton! The slower ball does the trick. Khawaja is slightly early into his shot. He ends up getting it off the inner half towards short mid-wicket where Bumrah takes an easy one. The dangerous and budding 46-run stand has come to an end and India need to keep taking wickets if they are to stem the run flow.
Inside edge! The slower ball outside off, Maxwell swings but gets an inside edge towards the leg side for a run.
Full and around off, Khawaja strokes it towards Bumrah at mid off. He misfields and a run is taken.
Mohammed Shami is back.
Length ball on off, Khawaja milks it to long off for a run.
On off, Maxi pushes it to long off and takes a single.
Full outside off, Khawaja drives it to cover and gets to the other end.
Good length ball on leg, Maxwell looks to pull it across the line. He misses it and gets hit on the pad. The ball rolls to the leg side and a leg bye is stolen.
Good length delivery on off, Khawaja flicks it to deep square leg for a single.
Full outside off, Usman goes chasing after it but misses.

100 for Khawaja! His maiden in ODIs. He has crafted his innings wonderfully here. He gets this with a clip on the leg side for a single. He took his time to get to the milestone but it is now time for him to step on the gas.
An appeal but it is an ambitious one. Flatter and outside off, it turns back in. Khawaja looks to flick but is hit too high on the pads.
Does the smart thing. Since this ball was not there to hit, he guides it towards point for a run.
FOUR! Elegant! 14 from the first three balls. This time, Maxwell makes room and also steps down the track. He goes inside out over covers for another boundary. Maxwell is on the charge here.

FOUR! A wild slog and it gets him the desired result. Picks his spot as there is no fielder in the deep mid-wicket region. Hits it over the fielder in the ring and bags a boundary. 10 from the first two balls.
SIX! Just over! Second for Maxwell. A little too full on middle, Maxwell hits it hard to the right of the fielder at long on. He stretches a hand out but fails to reach it. It goes all the way.
He stays on 99 as he guides this to point.
Angles it into the batsman, it is worked through mid-wicket for a run. Khawaja has one ball to go in this over to get to his ton.
FOUR! Gorgeous shot! Steps down the track and converts it into a half volley. Maxwell then strokes it through extra cover and it races away to the fence.
Waits for it and then guides it down to third man for a run.
Times it nicely but finds the man at covers.
Slightly shorter in length around off, Khawaja gets his pull through mid-wicket and takes two. Moves onto 98.
Vijay Shankar is back on.
Single to finish the over. Loopy delivery on middle, Usman guides it to long on and keeps the strike.
Tossed up on middle and leg, Khawaja tucks it to the fielder at mid-wicket.
Flighted on middle and leg, Maxwell nudges it to long on for another single.
On the pads, Usman flicks it towards fine leg and gets to the other end. Moves to 95 with that.
On middle and leg, Glenn tucks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Flighted on middle, Maxwell taps it back to the bowler.

Drinks Break - India have got a wicket but Australia are still on top here. India will look to get rid of the new batsma and not let the new batsmen anytime to settle. Australia, on the other hand, will hope that Maxwell can continue his good form and continue from where his skipper left. Usman Khawaja is still out there, He is well set on 94 and he will be looking to get to his maiden ODI ton. Ravindra Jadeja to bowl after drinks.
Works it with the turn through square leg for a run. A good one for the Aussies, 8 from it.
Works it with the turn through square leg for a run.
Flatter and it is on off, Maxwell is guilty of going too hard at the ball and he gets an inside edge on the leg side.

SIX! That has gone a long way up in the air but also clears the ropes! 200 up for Australia. Tossed up ball on middle, Maxwell clears his front leg and hits it high up in the over but clears the long off fence.

Direct hit needed but misses! You normally see Jadeja hit the stumps but this time he does not. Khawaja taps it towards point. Both the batsmen hesitate before going for a run. Jadeja picks the ball up and fires it at the non-striker's end but misses.
On the shorter side, Khawaja goes back and cuts it to point.
Length ball on off, Maxwell pushes it to point and straight away refuses a single.
Length ball around off, Usman guides it to third man and takes a single.
Off cutter on a length, Khawaja pushes it towards cover. Kohli there dives to his left and saves run for his side.
Good length delivery on off, Khawaja tucks it to the fielder at mid-wicket.
Full again this time on off, Glenn hits it wide of the mid off fielder and takes a quick single.
Full length delivery on off, Maxwell hits it straight. Bumrah stretches his right hand and gathers the ball.
Floats it up on off, Maxwell strokes it down to long off and is off the mark straightaway. End of a successful over by Kuldeep.
Promotion for Glenn Maxwell. He replaces his skipper and walks out at number 3.

OUT! It has pitched in line, hitting in line and is hitting the middle stump! Kuldeep Yadav has provided what India wanted. The mammoth 193-run stand has been broken. Finch falls in the nervous 90s. This is flatter and around middle, it pitches and turns back in. Finch goes back to play it but is a little late in bringing his bat down. It hits the front pad. An appeal follows and the umpire agrees. Finch reviews after having a chat with his partner. Replays roll in and it shows the on-field call is the right one. Finch takes a review along with him but his partnership with Khawaja has laid the foundation for the visitors. However, India have not got an opening, can they pull this back?
Australia review! Finch has been given out LBW. He has reviewed.  The question is where has it pitched?
Uses his feet and takes it on the full, he looks to flick but gets an inside edge to short fine leg.
The googly on middle, Finch keeps it out.
Floats it up on off, Khawaja taps it towards cover and gets to the other end. The fielder has a shy at the bowler's end but misses.
A little too full, this is eased down to long on for a run.
Full length delivery on off, Khawaja defends it towards point and shouts a loud no to his partner.
Fuller this time on off, Aaron nudges it to deep cover and gets a run.
Length ball on off and middle, Finch confidently blocks it.
Good length on off, Khawaja guides it to third man for a single.
Play and a misses. Good length delivery on off and middle, Khawaja looks to pull but misses.
Wide! Bumrah misses his line and bowl this down the leg side. Usman looks to flick but misses. Wide signalled.
Length delivery on the off stump line, Khawaja guides it wide of Mohammed Shami at third man with a straight bat and gets a couple.
Jasprit Bumrah is back on.
Howzzat? The answer to that question is not out. Tossed up outside off. Finch looks to sweep but misses. It hits his pads. An appeal follows but the umpire shakes his head. Impact was an issue.
FOUR! Into the gap and into the 90s is Finch. Uses his feet and then whips it over the mid-wicket fielder. No one in the deep and it is a boundary.
A little short and on off, Khawaja waits for the ball to do its bit and then pushes it through covers for a run.
Loopy ball on middle, Finch strokes it down to long off and gets to the other end.
Gives it a lot more air on off, Khawaja hits it down to long off for a single.
Flatter and shorter around off, it is cut towards point. The fielder there misfields but does not concede a run.
Flighted on the stumps, Usman sweeps it away and keeps the strike for the start of next over.
Tossed up on off, Finch nudges it to long off for a single.
Shorter on off, Finch cuts it hard but straight to the fielder at point.
On the pads, Khawaja flicks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Quicker outside off, Khawaja looks to sweep it but gets hit on the pads. Appeal is turned down by the umpire.
Tossed up on off, Usman blocks it.
FOUR! End of another expensive over! 12 from it. Finch looks to sweep but it goes off the inner half, fine down the leg side and it goes to the fine leg fence.
A little short and outside off, Khawaja goes back and cuts it through point for a run. Sensible batting.
SIX! Slog sweep and it has been dispatched! Gives it air does Kuldeep. Khawaja goes down on one knee and hits it over the mid-wicket stands.
Drags his length back a little and it is flatter. Finch goes back and tries to flick but misses to get hit on the pads. The ball rolls towards short fine leg. A leg bye taken.
Another one on the stumps, Finch happily defends it.
Floats it up on off, Finch keeps it out.
A dot to end! Flatter and on off, it is kept out.
Waits for the ball to come to him and then he guides it through point for a run.
Works it with the turn through mid-wicket for a run.
Flighted ball but it is a little too full. Finch strokes it down to long off for a run.
Flatter and on the stumps, it is kept out.
Leading edge! Hint of turn there for Jadeja. This is fired on middle, Finch goes back and looks to work it on the leg side, the ball straightens. Takes a soft leading edge towards point.
Ravindra Jadeja is back into the attack.
Single to end the over. On middle and leg, Finch flicks it to the on side and keeps the strike.
Tossed up on middle, Khawaja milks it to long on and gets to the other end.
Short on off, Usman gets on his back foot and cuts it towards backward point and gets a couple.
Flighted on middle and leg, Aaron pushes it to long on and takes a single.

Appeal but turned down. Flighted delivery on middle and leg, Finch looks to sweep but gets hit on the pad. The players appeal but the umpire turns it down. The replay shows Finch had gloved it so good decision.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
FOUR! Ends the over with a boundary! 11 from it. Short and wide outside off, it is cut through point. Away from the third man fielder. The change of ends has worked against Shankar and India.
Excellent fielding! Another top shot. This time it is through covers. Rayudu makes good ground to his right, dives and saves two for his side.

FOUR! How easy was that? Slightly short and on the body, Khawaja waits for it and then pulls it fine through the backward square leg region. No one in the deep, a boundary. 150 up for the Aussies. The platform is laid here for a big score.
A little too straight again, it is worked towards mid-wicket.
Full and straight, Finch strokes it down to long on for a run.
Angled into the off pole, Finch blocks it out.
Change of ends for Vijay Shankar.
FOUR! Khawaja looks in great form today. Shorter in length, Khawaja picks the length early and pulls it over the mid-wicket fielder for a boundary.
Shorter just outside off, khawaja taps it towards the third man region. The slip fielder dives to his left and stops a single.
Loopy delivery on middle and leg, Finch pushes it to long on and gets to the other end.
Flighted outside off, Aaron guides it to the fielder at short third man.
Shorter in length around off, Usman gets on his back foot and punches it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Floated on middle, Khawaja tucks it to the fielder at mid-wicket.
Kuldeep Yadav is back. India need a wicket here, can he provide it?
FOUR! Poor, poor fielding there. Length delivery around off, Finch hits it towards cover. Vijay Shankar misfields a regular fielding effort and the ball goes past him for a boundary.
Fuller length delivery on the stumps, Aaron blocks it off his front foot.
Good length delivery on middle and leg, Finch flicks it between long on and deep mid-wicket and gets a couple.
Length ball on off, Finch defends it with soft hands and looks for a quick single. Khawaja though turns him down.
Length delivery outside off, Finch looks to hit on the off side with an angled bat but he gets an inside edge and the ball goes to Dhoni on a bounce.

Another inswinger missed by Finch. Good length delivery pitching on leg, Aaron looks to play it to the leg side but misses. Shami goes up in appeal but the umpire turns it down. Hawk Eye shows it would have gone down the leg side.
A dot to end! Full and wide outside off, Khawaja looks to drive but gets it off the inner half towards mid off.
Continuously bowling it on off. Finch looks to defend but gets an inside edge towards short fine leg for another single.
Outside off, the batsman opens the face of the bat and guides it down to third man for a run.
Bowls it wide outside off again, Finch strokes it to the left of mid off and takes a run.
A little too straight, Khawaja whips it through mid-wicket. Dhawan in the deep runs to his right and pushes the ball back in play. Three taken.
On the fuller side, Khawaja looks to drive but it goes off the toe end to covers.
Another one on the off stump, Finch again guides it to point. A good over this by Shami.
On the off stump, guided to point.
Outside off, the batter opens the face and guides it down to third man for a single.

Another appeal but once again it is too high! Gets this one to tail back in. Finch looks to flick but seems to have missed it. The ball hits his pads and rolls towards point. The batsmen take a run, in the meantime, the batsmen take a run. The umpire has not signaled anything, so there might be an inside edge.
Back of a length on off, Finch goes back and keeps it out.
On the shorter side, Khawaja goes back and pulls it towards fine leg for a run. Too easy for the Aussies at the moment.
Slower ball outside off, left alone. A good over this by Shankar.
Nicely timed down the ground. There is protection in the deep so just a run.
Misfield! India have not been at their best here in the field! On the shorter side outside off, Finch hits it towards point. Jadeja there fails to collect it and a run is conceded.
A little too straight, this is worked around the corner for a run.
Closer to the off pole this time, Khawaja finds the man at cover.
Slightly short and outside off, Khawaja guides it to point.
Vijay Shankar replaces Kuldeep Yadav. Another 1 over spell for Kuldeep today.

Fifty for Usman Khawaja. He is making India pay for the life they gave him. He though has consistently got off to starts in this series. Can he make it count this time? Time will tell. He gets to the milestone by flicking it through square leg for a run.
A little bit of swing into the batsman, it is on the fuller side. Finch strokes it towards the bowler, he fails to collect it cleanly and a run is taken.
A little too straight here, Khawaja stylishly flicks it through backward square leg for a run.
On the fuller side on middle, Khawaja works it to mid on.
Slower ball, Finch walks into the cover drive. He hits it uppishly but wide of cover for a run.
Full and on the pads, Khawaja looks to flick but misses. It hits his pads and then rolls towards the fine leg region. A leg bye taken!

Drinks Break - Australia clearly on top here at the moment. The openers are still out there and are looking good. India are desperately looking for a wicket but have not been able to strike. Mohammad Shami has bowled just 3 overs so far and has gone out with injury. India will hope that he can come back and bowl his quota. Australia meanwhile, will hope the skipper and Khawaja continue their good work. Good news for India. Mohammed Shami is back to bowl after Drinks.

FOUR! Swept and swept excellently! However, it is a sloppy effort in the field. Finch goes down on one knee and hits it hard towards deep square leg. The fielder there is done in by the spin on the ball and concedes a boundary. Spoils what was a good over till then.
Very full, almost a yorker on off, Finch jams it out to covers.
Another tossed up ball on off, Finch strokes it to covers.
On the shorter side and outside off, Khawaja goes back and pushes it through covers for a run.
Another floated delivery outside off, left alone.
Slower through the air outside off, Khawaja looks to cut but gets it off the bottom half onto the off side.
No, Finch relaxes and tucks it towards mid-wicket for a single.

SIX! Just about clears the fielder. Flighted on middle and off, Finch lofts it over long on. Kuldeep Yadav at long on is in the picture for a moment. He jumps and outstretches his right hand but it goes over him for a maximum. Finch would have had his heart in his mouth for a moment. Will he make it get one more boundary in the next ball?

FOUR! Milestone ball! The skipper gets to his fifty and 100 up for Australia. Short wide and punished by Finch. Jadhav pulls his length back and Finch cuts it to the point fence for a boundary. 19th ODI fifty for the skipper and a much needed one. He is clicking at the right time for the Australians.
SIX! Finch goes down town. Flighted on middle, Finch gets his front leg away from the line and sends the ball over the long on fence for a maximum.
Full on off and middle, Khawaja strokes it to cover and takes a single.
Single to end the over. Khawaja runs it down to third man and keeps the strike.
Length ball on off stump, Usman hits it straight to the cover fielder.
Once again Shankar bowls it on length around off, Finch milks it to deep cover and gets to the other end.
Length delivery on off, Khawaja guides it to third man and rotates the strike.
Slightly fuller this one on off, Finch defends it with soft hand and takes a quick single.
Good length delivery on middle and leg, Finch tucks it to the fielder at short fine leg.
Uses his feet and strokes it down to long off for a single.
On the stumps, kept out.
This is stroked down to long on for a single.
On the shorter side outside off, Khawaja looks to cut but gets a bottom edge towards the off.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket. They pick up a single.

Another wide! This is down the leg side again. Finch looks to sweep but misses. Dhoni fails to collect it and the batsmen run two. However, replays show that the ball had brushed the gloves off Finch. The umpire misses out there.
Slow and down the leg side, Finch tries to hit it fine but misses. It has been wided but Finch will feel he missed out on a boundary there.
There is an issue with the ball. New ball will be required as the previous one has been stuck on the fence behind the boundary line.
SIX! All the way! First of the game! Tosses it up around off, Finch reaches out for it and lofts it over the long on fence for a biggie.
Kedar Jadhav is on now.
The batsman has driven it through mid on.
Almost chops it on! Closer to the off pole, Finch looks to guide it down to third man but it is too close to play that shot. He gets underedge on the off side for a single.
A low full toss on the stumps, it is driven back towards the bowler crisply but Shankar does well to get a hand to it and stop it.
Goes wide of the crease and angles it into the batsman, it has been blocked out.
Good use of the wrists there. Full and on off, Khawaja works it with against the angle towards mid on for a run.
Good length on off, Finch pushes it down towards long on for a run.
So six singles in this over as this is stroked down to long off for a run.
Another single as this is worked around the corner for a run.
Full and on the stumps, this is driven once again down to long on for a run.
Flighted ball again on middle, Khawaja works it down to long on and gets to the other end.
Floats it up and on the stumps, this is eased down to long on for a run.
Flatter and outside off, Khawaja goes back and guides it through point for a run.
So just a single from the 5 balls bowled after being hit for a boundary. Full and on off, Finch strokes it back to the bowler.
Continues bowling the line outside off, the batter gets bat to this one and eases it down to long off for a run.
Similar length and wide outside off, Khawaja looks to cut but misses. Good comeback this after going for a boundary on the first ball.
Well bowled again! Khawaja uses his feet and comes down the track, ends up playing inside the line though and gets beaten.
Drags his length back juts a little and it is a little more outside off. Khawaja goes after it but misses.
FOUR! Another bowler who starts his spell with a boundary. A half volley, too easy for the batsman. He just leans into it and strokes it through extra cover for a boundary.
Vijay Shankar is on now.
Flighted on middle and leg, Khawaja keeps the strike by stroking it to long on for a single.
Follows it up with a single. Floated on off, Finch guides it to long off for a single.
FOUR! Short, wide and punished. Jadeja bowls it outside off, Finch sees the length. His eyes lit up seeing the width on offer and slaps it through point for a boundary.

Bat involved. Flighted delivery on off and middle, Khawaja looks to paddle. It hits his bat and then thigh pad. The ball goes towards fine leg for a single. Jadeja asks the question but the umpire is unmoved.
Flighted on the stumps, Usman defends it off his front foot.
Off spinner, shorter in length. Khawaja premeditates his sweep and hits it towards square leg for a couple.
Powerplay 2 has been signalled by the umpire. 4 fielders can be placed outside the 30-yard circle till the 40th over.

A dot to end Powerplay 1. It has been all Australia in the first 10. They are not only going at a good rate but have also not lost a wicket. The last ball is a flatter one on off by Yadav. Finch goes back and pushes it to covers.

FOUR! Up and over! 50 comes up, consecutive 50-run opening stands for the Aussies here. Ideal start for them. This is tossed up on middle, Finch lofts it over the bowler' head. No fielder behind him and another boundary.
Bowls this flatter and on middle, the batter goes back and works it to mid-wicket.
Takes a decent enough stride and then strokes it to mid off.
Flighted ball on the stumps, Finch lunges and keeps it out.
FOUR! Welcome into the attack, Kuldeep! On the pads, Finch goes back and flicks it, it beats the man at short fine leg and then races to the fence.
Attacks the off pole, Khawaja goes back and keeps it out.
A little more fuller, Khawaja works it with the turn towards mid-wicket.
FOUR! Reverse swing played excellently once again. He hits it right off the middle and right in the gap through point.
Uses his feet but does not get to the pitch of the ball, he then works it with the turn to short fine leg.
Flatter and outside off, Khawaja lunges and blocks it out.
On the shorter side, Finch goes back and pushes it towards mid on for a single.
On the middle pole, UK strokes it to mid on. A dot to end another good over for Australia. Runs have started to come now.
FOUR! Easy pickings! On the pads, Khawaja flicks it through square leg. It beats the man there who tries and stops it. It races to the fence.
Shortish and outside off again, Khawaja looks to drag his pull but gets it off the bottom edge towards square leg.
BEATEN! This is bowled on a length and around off, it angles away. Khawaja hangs his bat out and gets beaten.
A little bit of width on offer, Finch opens the face and guides it down to third man for a run.
Back of a length on off, Finch punches it to covers.

FOUR! Adding salt to the wounds this! Dropped on the ball before the last one and now hits it a boundary. Shortish and outside off, Khawaja goes back and punches it through covers. It races to the fence. Expensive start by Jadeja.
Works it with the turn to mid-wicket.

DROPPED! That should have been taken! Yes, that was hit nicely and it was away from the fielder but still, once you get two hands to it, it should be taken. Khawaja again brings out the reverse sweep, nails it off the middle but it is uppish and too close to the point fielder. Dhawan there dives to his left, gets two hands to it, tries to catch it but fails to do so. A reprieve for the left-hander. Can he now make use of this life?
Flatter and outside off, Khawaja looks to hit it through the off side against the turn but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
FOUR! Innovation! Straightaway brings out the reverse sweep. Jadeja bowls it very full and on off. Khawaja hits it through third man and into the fence.
Starts off with a tossed up delivery, Finch eases it down to long off for a run.
Ravindra Jadeja is on now.

FOUR! Edgy but Khawaja will take it. Good length delivery on off, Khawaja has a poke at it but gets a thick outside edge. The ball goes to the vacant third man region for a boundary. The first ball of the over deserved a boundary but that was a dot and the last ball of the over didn't deserve to go for a boundary but it has. That's cricket though.
Good length delivery on off, Khawaja rocks onto his front foot and blocks it.
Length delivery outside off, Finch dabs it to third man and gets to the other end.
Back of a length delivery on middle and off, Aaron hits it straight to the fielder at mid-wicket.
Good length delivery on the off stump line, Finch calmly defends it.
Good shot but for no reward. Full length delivery on off, Finch hits it straight but Bumrah gets down in time and gets his right hand to it. The ball then goes to the mid on fielder.

Good shot and well fielded! Good cricket all around. Nothing bad with the delivery, it is on a length and around middle, Finch times it towards mid on. Kuldeep there runs to his left and then dives to save three for his side. Good this from India, they have managed to keep it tight after the first two overs. Just 6 runs from the last 3 overs.
A little too straight, the batter works it to mid-wicket.

Almost a run out there! That would have been unfortunate had that hit the stumps. To start with Shami bowls a fuller ball on off, Finch with the full face of the bat strokes it back towards the bowler. He starts running as he plays the shot. The ball though hits Shami's leg and then goes to short mid-wicket. Kohli there collects the ball and now Finch has to scamper back. The Indian skipper has a shy at the keeper's end but misses. Would have been close had he hit.
A little on the shorter side, Finch works it to mid-wicket.
Takes a few steps ahead but Shami spots that. He shortens his length and continues bowling it on the stumps. Finch blocks it out.
On the stumps, not a lot you can do with that. Finch pushes it to covers.
Loose shot! Short and wide outside off, Khawaja once again throws his bat at it but is beaten by the extra bounce.
OHHHH! The tempter, full and outside off, Khawaja has a go at it but ends up getting beaten inside the line. Dhoni does well to go low and collect it.
Back of a length on off, Khawaja works it around the corner for no runs.
FOUR! Once you beat the infield, you need not run here. Slightly short and Khawaja picks the length early. He pulls it through square leg and the ball races to the fence.
Crisply drive but straight to the man at covers. Looks a good pitch this till now, no swing on offer and it seems to be coming onto the bat nicely.
Back of a length angling away from the batter. Khawaja defends it off the back foot.
Length delivery on off to end the over. Aaron blocks it to see off the over. Excellent over from Shami, just one run off it.
On the pads, Finch tucks it to the fielder at mid-wicket.
Length ball on middle and leg, Finch defends it to the fielder at mid on.
Good length delivery on off, Aaron taps it back to the bowler.

Excellent delivery! Inswinging ball pitching on off, Finch looks to play it across the line but misses and gets hit on the pads. Shami goes up in appeal but the umpire turns it down. Looked close but no review left for the Indians.
Good length delivery on middle and leg, Khawaja glances it to fine leg and takes a single.
Another in-dipper, Finch once again fails to put bat on ball and gets hit on the pads. This was a little too down the leg side.

NOT OUT! Going over! India lose a review very early. A poor one to be honest. Considering that Finch was jumping while playing that. A good delivery though by Bumrah. He goes wide of the crease and angles it in on a length. Finch goes back and looks to flick with both feet up in the air. Misses and is hit above the knee role. An appeal follows but the umpire shakes his head. Kohli then has a chat with his bowler and Dhoni and then reviews. Replays roll in and it shows the on-field call is the right one.
A review in as early as the second over! It is taken by India as an appeal for an LBW has been turned down. Finch is the man in question. Looks high.

FOUR! Uppish but well wide! On the shorter side outside off, Finch guides it uppishly but wide of point for the second boundary of the over. Finch is off to a good start here, we saw him find some sort of form in the last game.
A little fuller than the last ball and closer to the off pole, Finch goes back and defends it onto the ground.
FOUR! A very confident shot! On the shorter side, Finch stands tall and punches it through covers. You need not run for those as the outfield here is lightning quick. First boundary for Finch.
Lands it on a length and just outside off, Finch lunges forward and keeps it out.
Jasprit Bumrah to bowl from the other end.
This is on the fourth stump line, Khawaja knows where his off stump is and leaves it alone. 6 runs off the first over.
Wide! Shami bowls it too wide of the off stump line. It is outside the tramline. Wide signalled.
Good length delivery on the stumps, Khawaja blocks it.
On the fifth stump line, Usman leaves it alone. Khawaja looks at the umpire to check if it has been wided. The umpire though is happy with the delivery.
FOUR! First boundary of the day and it comes from the bat of Usman Khawaja. Length delivery on the pads, Usman flicks it off his pads through mid-wicket for a boundary. Good way to get off the mark.
Good ball! Length delivery outside off, Khawaja has a poke at it but misses.

Shami starts right on the money with an incoming yorker.  Finch looks to flick but misses it. It hits him on his boot and there is a stiffled appeal from the bowler but the umpire turns it down. They take a run as the ball goes towards the fine leg region. It looked like it was going down the leg.
We are all set for the action to begin! The Australian openers, Aaron Finch and Usman Khawaja walk out to the middle. Mohammed Shami to bowl the first over. Here we go...

Australian skipper, Aaron Finch, says he wasn't sure but he would have probably bowled first. Informs they have one change as Jhye Richardson comes in for Nathan Coulter-Nile who flies back for the birth of his second child. Mentions they have enjoyed playing here but he wished they could have gotten over the line in the close encounters. Ends by saying if they play their best cricket, they have a chance.

Indian skipper, Virat Kohli, says they want to bowl first. Mentions it looks like a decent track. Reckons it should be a little slow in the afternoon and also dew should come in play in the second innings. States the cap they are wearing is a tribute to the Martyrs of the Pulwama attack. Also, the match fees of this game will be donated to the defense fund. Informs they are playing the same team. Ends by saying he is very pleased with the first two ODIs as they had to grind for their victories.
TOSS - Up goes the coin and it lands in the favor of the Indians. They will bowl first.

Murali Kartik and Sunil Gavaskar at the pitch report say there is darkness on one side of the pitch than the other side. Reckon that the ball will come onto the bat nicely and will spin more on the darker side. Mention the dew factor will influence the decision of the captain and reckon they will bowl first.

Hello and welcome to the third ODI of this 5-match series between India and Australia. The hosts are 2-0 up in the series and will look to seal it today with a win. Australia meanwhile, have fought close battles with India in the previous games but haven't been able to get over the line. They will look to get that right and crawl their way back into the series. If the first two games is anything to go by, then we can expect a hard fought cricketing contest here in Ranchi. Stay tuned for further updates...
